# Server tests the navmesh workflow (.github/workflows/navmesh.yml) runs against the published navmesh set (issues #684,
# #687).
#   UT_Name[.Method]  # what it checks, and what of the set it reads (#issue)
# Each one is an [Explicit] class that stays on .github/ci-excluded-tests.txt (the server job has no navmeshes), and needs
# nothing but the set: runtime/server/navmesh, runtime/server/lib/Detour.dll and (#687) the set's clean world database,
# which the job puts at ../data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db beside the meshes and in OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH. No played state, no
# captured log, no input file. A tool with no assertion is not listed: its pass would prove nothing.
# tools/navmesh/navmesh_set.py check checks the list. A test that fails here gets a real fix, or its own issue and a
# quarantine line in ci-excluded-tests.txt.
# Navmeshes and Detour only (#684)
UT_DragonLairProbe  # the three dragon lairs' homes are grounded, reachable from outside and keep safe teleports (#684)
UT_SneezerCampNavigation  # the Domnann camp spawns have walkable floors reachable from the original spot (#684)
UT_ExchangePlacementNavigation.InspectCapitalFloors  # the Jordheim and Tir na Nog meshes load and answer queries (#684)
# Navmeshes and the clean world database (#687)
UT_AllFrontierKeepRoutes  # every frontier keep's routes simulated on the meshes from the world's keeps (#687)
UT_AuditedDungeonInstalledMesh  # dungeon coverage of the meshes for the world's dungeon regions (#687)
UT_CurrentDungeonGoalRoutes  # native routes for every current ordinary dungeon goal (#687)
UT_ExpeditionInteriorCapacity  # epic interior formation room on the meshes (#687)
UT_InstalledKeepRoutes  # keep navigation from the world's keeps and doors (#687)
UT_InstalledPorterWaiting  # teleporter waiting spots on the meshes (#687)
UT_PlayerTravelInstalledMesh  # player travel points (zone points, town centres) on the meshes (#687)
UT_RealmExchangeRelocation  # the Realm Exchange relocation proof on the meshes (#687)
UT_RecentHibDungeonSeams  # the Hibernian dungeon exterior routes (#687)
UT_September11HotspotProbe  # the September 11 hotspot navigation checks (#687)
UT_SeptemberFourteenInstalledNavigation  # the September 14 incident probes (#687)
UT_SeptemberTenRouteProbe  # the September 10 route evidence (#687)
UT_SiegeIncidentNavigation  # keep-approach incident checks (#687)
UT_SiegeFiringPositions  # a connected ram position at the three realms' outer gates, from the world's keeps and doors (#704)
UT_StarterDungeonInstalledMesh  # every eligible starter-dungeon spawn is audited and routes from the entrance and back (#704)
UT_SeamCycle555  # the 11/23 seam cycle at 200:334880,417728 replayed on the set: the trip reaches the camp and never turns back (#555)
# The clean world database only (#687)
UT_AnimistInstalledCatalog  # the Animist spell and template catalog in the world (#687)
UT_InstalledClassicMeleeAudit  # the Classic styles and poisons in the world (#687)
UT_SiegeMerchantCatalog  # the siege merchants' lists in the world (#687)
UT_SeptemberNineInstalledRoutes  # the installed portal approaches; an off-edge capture plans from its floor step (#704)
UT_SeptemberThirteenInstalledRoutes  # the installed camp approaches; an off-edge capture plans from its floor step (#704)
